blocks.text: A write batch applies several writes together. Either the batch is accepted as a unit or it fails.

Use the Firebase Emulator Suite with the demo-reading-club project and Firestore on port 8080. Install the firebase JavaScript SDK in a local browser project. Run each full snippet on a fresh page. Keep the sample rules local.

items: `writeBatch` collects writes for one commit. A value-dependent change needs a transaction that also reads.
`connectFirestoreEmulator` sends this SDK instance to the local emulator address before database operations begin.

blocks.text: Both local sample books are written together when the rules allow both writes.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A batch does not read values first. Use a transaction for changes that depend on a value read from the database.
